notes.title: Next Playtest Launches June 20, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the long silence — we know many of you were waiting for news on M.I.N.S.K. Robotics, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. This project is made by just two people in our spare time, and your feedback, wishlists, and enthusiasm keep us going. Thank you!

Now for the good news: the second playtest launches on June 20!

We’ve made major improvements based on your feedback:

- Controls now feel heavier and more immersive.,
- The flashlight is gone — you now have a drone for light and communication.,
- Health is tied to energy — shooting and damage consume it; you restore it by moving and collecting batteries.,
- A new zone, The Hospital, is accessible after solving an environmental puzzle.,
- The tutorial is smoother, and enemies spawn dynamically based on your progress.,

If you're a content creator and want early access — let us know! - sodesign.games@gmail.com

Thanks for staying with us. See you on June 20!

— M.I.N.S.K. Robotics Team
